description: The taxonomic diversity, evolution, ecology and conservation of North Pacific fishes. Laboratory and field topics include fish identification, stable isotope methodologies, database design and statistical analyses, and collecting/fishing techniques. A student field research project is required.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of:
    • BIOL215 - Principles of Ecology (1.5)
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of MRNE 412, BIOL 431, BIOL 431A (if taken prior to May 2011).
  • This is a field course offered at the Bamfield Marine Sciences Centre for upper level Biology credit. Please visit the Bamfield Marine Sciences Centre website for more information.
title: Biology of Marine Fishes
